findings.summary: The fixed black/yellow palette does not respond to the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The light and dark captures retain the same palette, and the DOM reports color-scheme: normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven surface and text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route and state changes have no View Transition treatment.
findings.evidence: The runtime CSS probe found zero view-transition rules on this multi-route site.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document and cross-document View Transitions for route and major state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The very long feed has no scroll-aware navigation or progress cue.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout measured 32,716px of content while the header scrolls away and no scroll-state or timeline CSS was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep essential navigation available and add a lightweight declarative scroll progress or scroll-state affordance.

findings.summary: An unsolicited install dialog obscures core content and form fields on load.
findings.evidence: Desktop, mobile, video, and registration screenshots show the PWA install card before user interaction; on registration it covers the email/password region.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not show the install prompt on load. Offer install after demonstrated intent and use a semantic, light-dismissible dialog without covering the active task.

findings.summary: Reusable cards adapt only at viewport level, with no component-level query support.
findings.evidence: The stylesheet runtime probe found zero @container rules despite cards appearing across grid, sidebar, and single-column contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/list containers container-type and use size-aware @container rules where component layout changes.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated on primary controls and fields.
findings.evidence: Focused visible login, email, password, Create account, Country, install, and menu controls all computed to outline: none and box-shadow: none while matching :focus-visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible ring with adequate offset; retain large touch targets and non-hover states.

findings.summary: The measured mobile load misses the LCP performance bar by a wide margin.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 9.9s, LCP 17.2s, and performance 0.56; the separate trace measured LCP 2.89s, showing high run variability but a clear slow-path failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redirect latency, prioritize the LCP image, and reduce eager network work; verify with repeated lab and field CWV measurements.

findings.summary: The page sends an excessive request/image payload and has inefficient cache and redirect behavior.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 202 requests and 2.76MB transferred, including 145 image requests; Lighthouse reported 7.98s redirect savings and cache/image-delivery opportunities.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate redirect chains, load only initial-viewport imagery eagerly, set durable cache headers, and prioritize only the LCP resource.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable unused, legacy, and unminified code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported about 32KiB unused CSS, 22KiB unused JS, 74KiB unminified JS savings, and 18KiB legacy-JS savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused rules and scripts, minify production assets, and avoid sending legacy code to modern browsers.

findings.summary: Some controls, images, and the on-load dialog lack robust accessible naming.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed dialog-name, image-alt, and form-label audits; the DOM probe also found icon-only buttons without accessible text.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native elements and explicit labels; give every icon-only action and dialog an accessible name, and meaningful images accurate alt text.

findings.summary: Some text and essential UI fail minimum color contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the color-contrast audit; the forced-colors screenshot remains operable but does not repair ordinary-theme contrast failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG contrast and preserve forced-colors behavior.

findings.summary: Visible keyboard focus is absent across the primary navigation and registration form.
findings.evidence: The direct focus probe found :focus-visible elements with no outline or box shadow, although landmarks and headings are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement a consistent :focus-visible treatment and test the full tab order on listing, player, and registration paths.

findings.summary: Image assets lack intrinsic sizing and responsive delivery metadata.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 99 of 100 images without width/height and 99 without srcset; 98 use legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height, responsive srcset/sizes, and modern encoded variants from the image pipeline.

findings.summary: Deprecated API and DevTools inspector issues remain in production.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported three deprecation warnings and a failed inspector-issues audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace deprecated APIs, resolve browser Issues-panel diagnostics, and keep dependencies current.

findings.summary: Session cookies and key browser security headers are unsafe or absent.
findings.evidence: All five observed cookies lacked Secure and used SameSite=None; session_id also lacked HttpOnly. CSP and X-Content-Type-Options were absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure, HttpOnly for session cookies, an appropriate SameSite policy, a restrictive CSP, and nosniff while retaining HTTPS/HSTS.

findings.summary: The initial page load contacts a broad advertising/tracking surface.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 11 third-party origins, while the HAR recorded 202 requests; no consent or minimization control appeared before those requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove nonessential partners, defer third parties until intent/consent, and document/minimize data sent to each origin.

findings.summary: Account creation exposes password-only authentication with no passkey path.
findings.evidence: The registration path contains username, email, and new-password fields; no WebAuthn/passkey affordance was observed. No permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration and authentication as the preferred path, retaining password fallback where required.

findings.summary: Clickjacking, referrer, and permissions defenses are not configured in response headers.
findings.evidence: Header evidence found no CSP/frame-ancestors, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; HSTS was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Set frame-ancestors (and a legacy X-Frame-Options fallback where needed), Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Locale-varying pages expose English-only relative dates and interface text.
findings.evidence: The UI offers country and hreflang variants but listing metadata remains phrases such as “2 days ago” and “A month ago” with no localized output observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Render relative dates and other locale-sensitive values with Intl APIs and localized message catalogs.

findings.summary: Registration fields do not expose client-side required constraints before submission.
findings.evidence: The register DOM marks login, email, and password as required:false; an empty submit navigated away rather than yielding inspectable in-place recovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare required constraints, validate after interaction, keep entered values, and announce an actionable error summary in place.

findings.summary: The image-heavy feed does not use modern, responsive delivery.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 98 legacy-format images and 99 without srcset; the HAR transferred 2.21MB across 145 image requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, responsive sources, intrinsic dimensions, and appropriate quality/resolution tiers.

findings.summary: Almost the entire long feed is fetched eagerly before it is needed.
findings.evidence: Of 100 audited images, 96 below-fold images were not lazy-loaded; HAR captured 145 image requests on initial load.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold media and defer/background-prioritize nonessential fetches until proximity or intent.

findings.summary: Third-party advertising and media consume a disproportionate initial-load budget.
findings.evidence: The initial load contacted 11 third-party origins and sent 202 requests; multiple live/ad units render alongside the primary grid.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, defer live/ad media, and load each integration only after it delivers clear user value.

taskList.title: Stop eager media and optimize responsive image delivery
Restore names, labels, contrast, and visible keyboard focus
Reduce and defer third-party advertising traffic
Add passkeys and humane in-place registration errors
Add preference-driven theming and modern navigation transitions
